description: Check a deck (scene list or A2UI payload) without building it. Returns every error with its slide, field and exact limit, warnings (no speaker notes, no link) and, for a payload, which atoms have no slide recipe. Not rate-limited.

deck.description: A typed scene list: {"title","target","scenes":[{"type":"title|bullets|stats|quote|table|media|cta","f":{...fields...},"notes":"speaker notes"}]}. Same scene fields as make_film (eyebrow, headline, sub, kicker, stats as [value,label] pairs, steps/items, quote, name, role, b1/l1, foot). Call deck_schema for every layout and limit. Give deck OR payload.

payload.description: An A2UI payload {"blocks":[{"type":"quote",...},...]}: each atom with a slide recipe becomes slides, others are listed under `unsupported`, never guessed. deck_schema lists the atoms. Give payload OR deck.

skip_film_only.description: For a scene list that came from a film: leave out scenes with no slide layout (chart, chat, word, morph, captions, image) instead of treating them as errors.

name: deck_validate

conversion.description: How a payload was converted to a deck, when one was given.

errors.description: Problems that stop a build, each with slide, code and message.

ok.description: True when there are no errors.

unsupported.description: Atoms the conversion could not carry.

warnings.description: Problems that do not stop a build.
